diagram_review.scope: Reviewed assigned ItemBody diagrams and algebraic maps for missing commutative-algebra, ideal-spectrum, localization, and exact-sequence diagrams, and checked displayed map/index/sign behavior.

missing_diagram_candidates.kind: optional commutative diagram for inverse systems and a short exact sequence
missing_diagram_candidates.content: A compact two-stage diagram could show the rows A_n --f_n--> B_n --g_n--> C_n and A_{n+1} --f_{n+1}--> B_{n+1} --g_{n+1}--> C_{n+1}, with inverse-system transition maps downward and commuting compatibility squares. This would ground the inverse-system convention behind the compatible fibers E_n and lift sequence.
missing_diagram_candidates.checks: The statement has exact rows and maps f_n,g_n at lines 35–39; proof lines 55 and 61 use restrictions B_{n+1}→B_n and compatible c_n. No displayed map, index, or sign error was observed.
missing_diagram_candidates.reason: It may help readers track transition maps and fibers in the surjectivity proof; the proof is already explicit and no diagram is required for rigor.

diagram_review.notes: Three confirmed raw-math rendering defects are recorded. No TikZ source defect or displayed algebraic map/index/sign error was observed. The inverse-system diagram is an optional editorial candidate only; no other figure is proposed.
